mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_daily_activity ( user_id, `date`, diet_logged, workout_logged, challenge_done, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{date}, #{dietLogged}, #{workoutLogged}, #{challengeDone}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE user_daily_activity SET diet_logged = #{dietLogged}, workout_logged = #{workoutLogged}, challenge_done = #{challengeDone}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND `date` = #{date}
